pages.text: $(l)Voltage observer$()$(br)Mount it on an electric block. It gives a $(item)redstone signal$() while that network has any voltage. A $(item)comparator$() reads it more finely: the strength grows with the voltage and is full at $(item)250 V$().

$(l)Display link sources$()$(br)Point a Create $(item)display link$() at:$(li)an $(item)electric gauge$() or a $(item)voltage observer$(): voltage, current, resistance, power used or generated, voltage generated, and the network's consumption, generation, resistance and id;
$(li)an $(item)accumulator$(): voltage and the network's consumption, generation and resistance;$(li)a $(item)potentiometer$(): voltage and voltage generated.

$(l)Segmented display$()$(br)A $(item)display link target$() that shows text with glowing segments, two characters per block. Place several side by side for longer text. It is a 100 ohm consumer and stays dark below $(item)5 W$(), so give it at least about 23 V. Right-click it with a dye to change its color (black and grays are refused).
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
